playbooks.title: Playbooks
playbooks.description: Reusable strategy pipelines for dedicated location tasks—configure once, run when you need them.
playbooks.actionsSheetDescription: Choose an action for this playbook.

validation.endBeforeStart: End date must be on or after the start date

deleteDialog.title: Remove playbook?
deleteDialog.description: “{name}” will be removed. This cannot be undone.

publicHolidays.title: Public Holidays
publicHolidays.description: Generate Instagram stories for public holidays in an upcoming date window.
publicHolidays.emptyDescription: Create a Public Holidays playbook to generate Instagram stories for upcoming holidays.
publicHolidays.createDescription: Configure the date window and generate Instagram stories for the holidays in that range.

form.locationDescription: Stories will be scoped to this restaurant location.
form.noLocationsDescription: Add a location before creating a Public Holidays playbook.

workspace.workspaceHint: Run saves the settings above and loads holidays for that window. Review candidates, confirm picks, draft stories, create visual briefs, then generate Artwork.
workspace.sessionAlertDescription: Confirmed holidays, story drafts, visual briefs, and artwork picks stay in this browser tab. Refresh or leave the page and they are lost.
workspace.aiRelevanceHint: When on, Run scores holidays and pre-checks likely story fits. When off, holidays load unchecked for manual selection.
workspace.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. skip Nyepi; prioritize Chinese New Year for this neighborhood
workspace.instructionsHint: Optional guidance for which holidays fit Instagram stories. Leave blank to use the default policy.
workspace.fetchError: Could not load public holidays. Try again.
workspace.candidatesCardDescription: Review holidays in the date window, then keep the ones you want to draft.
workspace.candidatesEmptyDescription: Adjust the settings above, then run to load public holidays for that window.
workspace.candidatesNoneDescription: No public holidays were found for this location between the start and end dates. Widen the date range and run again.
workspace.candidatesClearedDescription: All holidays were kept or skipped. Run again to reload holidays for this window.
workspace.confirmedEmptyDescription: Keep candidates here after you review them.

draft.settingsDescription: Optional guidance and quality checks before generating story drafts.
draft.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. warm tone; mention limited hours; keep captions under 80 characters
draft.instructionsHint: Optional guidance for drafting Instagram stories. Then generate one draft per confirmed holiday.
draft.critiqueEnabledHint: After drafting, AI scores the story against your criteria and revises until it passes or hits the iteration limit.
draft.critiquePromptPlaceholder: e.g. warm local tone; mention hours if limited; caption under 80 characters; no invented promotions
draft.critiquePromptHint: Describe what a successful story must satisfy. Used only when critique is on.
draft.critiqueMaxIterationsHint: Stops early when the score meets the minimum.
draft.critiqueMinScoreHint: Drafts at or above this score are accepted.
draft.candidatesEmptyDescription: Confirm holidays on Fetch dates first, then return here. Skipped drafts also leave this list empty until you confirm more holidays.
draft.confirmedEmptyDescription: Confirmed story drafts will appear here after you review candidates.
draft.draftError: Could not draft this story. Retry or skip.
draft.feedbackPlaceholder: e.g. shorter; less salesy; mention brunch hours
draft.feedbackHint: Your feedback revises this draft. The previous result is sent with your notes.
draft.generateError: Could not draft stories. Try again.

visualBriefs.settingsDescription: Pick a style reference, analyze it once, then generate a visual brief per confirmed story draft.
visualBriefs.styleReferenceHint: Required. This image is the visual foundation for all holiday story artworks.
visualBriefs.styleReferencePickerAria: Select a style reference image from Media
visualBriefs.styleReferenceEmpty: No media images yet. Upload photos in Media first.
visualBriefs.styleAnalyzeHint: Analyze the style image before generating briefs.
visualBriefs.styleReadyHint: Style foundation ready. Generate briefs for the holidays below.
visualBriefs.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. warm evening light; keep framing 9:16; no text overlays in the image
visualBriefs.instructionsHint: Optional art-direction notes applied when analyzing style and drafting briefs.
visualBriefs.candidatesEmptyDescription: Confirm story drafts on Draft stories first, then return here. Skipped items also leave this list empty until you confirm more drafts.
visualBriefs.confirmedEmptyDescription: Confirmed visual briefs will appear here after you review candidates.
visualBriefs.briefError: Could not draft this visual brief. Retry or skip.
visualBriefs.feedbackPlaceholder: e.g. more food focus; softer light; less clutter
visualBriefs.feedbackHint: Your feedback revises this brief. The previous result is sent with your notes.
visualBriefs.generateError: Could not draft visual briefs. Try again.
visualBriefs.analyzeError: Could not analyze the style image. Try again.

artwork.settingsDescription: Generate Instagram story images from confirmed visual briefs via Leonardo.
artwork.generateHint: Each confirmed brief becomes one 9:16 story image using the shared style reference.
artwork.candidatesEmptyDescription: Confirm visual briefs first, then return here. Skipped items also leave this list empty until you confirm more briefs.
artwork.confirmedEmptyDescription: Confirmed artwork picks will appear here after you review candidates.
artwork.feedbackPlaceholder: e.g. warmer light; less clutter; stronger holiday cue
artwork.feedbackHint: Your feedback revises the selected image. Previous artwork is sent with your notes.
artwork.generateError: Could not generate this image. Retry or skip.
artwork.generateBatchError: Could not generate artwork. Try again.

nearbyLocations.title: Nearby Locations
nearbyLocations.description: Map offices, schools, colleges, and other demand nodes near a restaurant location for local marketing context.
nearbyLocations.emptyDescription: Nearby Locations playbooks will help you discover and save interesting places around each restaurant. Create and run will be available in a future update.
